title: Thai Noodle Stir-Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with Thai noodles and a tangy tamarind sauce.

ingredients.name: Nutty oil (e.g. peanut or coconut oil)

instructions: Cook the Thai noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat the nutty oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the ball-shaped vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the tamarind sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Add the boat-shaped noodles (if using) and stir to combine.
